example.hakka: 屋下前背有一棚大樹仔。
example.romanization: vuk-ha chhiòn-póe yû yit pâng thai shu-é.
example.english: In front of the house there is a big tree.

note: The suffix 仔 (é) is very common in Hakka nouns, adding a casual, diminutive feel. Trees are counted with the measure word 棚 (pâng) in Sixian.
